# Paths that make a pull request consequential under the xekoms PR policy (rule 6).
# One extended regular expression per line, matched against each changed file path.
# A match adds the `needs-bradley` label, requires a filled-in "What Bradley needs to know"
# section, and requires Bradley's approval on the exact head before `ai-review` passes.
# The copy on the BASE branch is the one that is enforced, so a PR cannot loosen its own gate.
# Lines starting with # are comments.

# Database migrations, schema and data
(^|/)migrations?/
(^|/)supabase/
(^|/)schema(s)?(/|\.)
(^|/)prisma/
\.sql$

# Security, auth, RLS, permissions, ownership
(^|/)(auth|security|rls|policies|permissions|grants)(/|\.|_)
(^|/)SECURITY\.md$
(^|/)CODEOWNERS$

# Secrets and credentials
(^|/)\.env(\.|$)
(^|/)secrets?(/|\.)
(^|/)bws(/|\.)

# Deploys, DNS, infrastructure
(^|/)(deploy|deployment|infra|infrastructure|terraform|k8s|helm|ops)/
(^|/)wrangler\.(toml|json|jsonc)$
(^|/)vercel\.json$
(^|/)netlify\.toml$
(^|/)fly\.toml$
(^|/)Dockerfile[^/]*$
(^|/)docker-compose[^/]*\.ya?ml$

# CI, review rules and repository policy (changes to "these rules")
^\.github/workflows/
^\.github/ai-review/
^\.github/(pull_request_template|PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE)\.md$
^\.github/dependabot\.ya?ml$
